title: Longer, Heavier, Holds More: Length, Mass and Capacity
seo_title: Grade R Length, Mass and Capacity Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Length, mass and capacity
standard_text: Compare and order the length, height or width of two or more objects by placing them next to each other; compare the mass of objects by feeling them or using a balance; compare the amount of liquid in two containers.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: longer and shorter, taller, heavier and lighter, and holds more or less. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Line up the ends to compare length.
  • Feel two objects, or use a balance: the heavier side goes down.
  • Pour to compare: the container that holds more fills the other one and has some left.
  • To order, start with the shortest, lightest or smallest.

Examples

Example

On a balance, the box goes down and the ball goes up

the lower side is heavier

Answer: the box is heavier

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The endsLine up the ends first.
Big is heavyBig objects can be light.
Tall is moreA tall thin bottle can hold less.
